parho apney perwerdigar ka naam ley ker jiss ney sabb kuch peda kiya ,
uss ney insan ko jamay huye khoon say peda kiya hai .
parho , aur tumhara perwerdigar sabb say ziyada karam wala hai ,
jiss ney qalam say taleem di ,
insan ko uss baat ki taleem di jo woh nahi janta tha .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan khuli sarkashi ker raha hai
kiyonkay uss ney apney aap ko bey niaz samajh liya hai .
sach to yeh hai kay tumharay perwerdigar hi ki taraf sabb ko loattna hai .
bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jo aik banday ko mana kerta hai
bhala batlao kay agar woh ( namaz parhney wala ) hidayat per ho ,
ya taqwa ka hukum deta ho , ( to kiya ussay rokna gumrahi nahi-? )
bhala batlao kay agar woh ( rokney wala ) haq ko jhutlata ho , aur mun morrta ho ,
kiya ussay yeh maloom nahi hai kay Allah dekh raha hai ?
khabrdar ! agar woh baaz naa aaya , to hum ( ussay ) paishani kay baal pakar ker ghaseeten gay ,
uss paishani kay baal jo jhooti hai , gunehgaar hai .
abb woh bulaley apni majlis walon ko !
hum dozakh kay farishton ko bula len gay .
hergiz nahi ! uss ki baat naa maano , aur sajda kero , aur qareeb aajao .
